Ancestrals

The ancestrals are a group of monsters represented as constellations in the Elduran night sky. In the Kingdom, twelve prominent constellations can be found throughout the year, each of which associated with one of the ancestrals described here.

Cardinal Goat (Capricor)

Small and unassuming compared to the other ancestrals, capricor frequently live among common goats and other, similar monsters. The only sure way to spot one of the cardinal goats is to watch for the grass it eats to grow back moments later.

Monster Trainer Spells
Monstorin Stats

CAPRICOR
CR 15

XP 51,200
NG Large fey
Init +10; Senses low-light vision; Perception +19

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+6 Dex, +3 natural, –1 size)
hp 287 (25d6+200); fast healing 10
Fort +16, Ref +22, Will +17
Immune plant traits; Resist acid 5, cold 5, electricity 10

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft., fly 20 ft. (clumsy)
Melee slam +22 (1d8+11 plus daze), bite +22 (1d8+11), gore +22 (1d8+11), 2 hooves +17 (1d6+5)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks trample (2d8+22, DC 29)

STATISTICS

Str 33, Dex 23, Con 26, Int 12, Wis 17, Cha 14
Base Atk +12; CMB +24; CMD 40
Feats Awesome Blow, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Natural Attack (slam), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack
Skills Climb +47, Diplomacy +29, Fly +23, Heal +30, Perception +30, Sense Motive +30, Stealth +29 (+37 in heavy plant growth)
Languages Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Daze (Ex)

Any creature hit by a capricor’s slam attack must succeed on a DC 29 Fortitude save or be dazed 1d2 rounds. The save DC is Strength-based.
